extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Aetna plan available in Pinellas County has a $20 monthly premium, a $40 drug deductible and a $3200 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent discussed plan benefits before the disclaimer, which is compliant. The agent also collected the Scope of Appointment and scheduled a plan review, both of which were done in a timely manner.
composition.coaching_note: While the agent's process was compliant, it would be beneficial to ensure the disclaimer is read before discussing any plan benefits to avoid any potential confusion. For example, the agent could say, 'Before we discuss the plan details, I need to inform you that we do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.'
